name: Kickresume
shortDescription: Resume builder whose AI writes bullets from a job title. Free to try. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Kickresume's homepage says its AI resume writer generates work-experience bullets from a job title, and that you can score a resume and tailor it to a job description. The page says the builder is free to try. It did not list a monthly plan price.
pricingNotes: The homepage says the builder is free to try. It did not list a monthly plan price.
freeTierNotes: The homepage says the builder is free to try and does not spell out a lasting free plan.
